Interface ICurrencypairSearchProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
BoursoramaSecuritySearch, OnvistaSecuritySearch
public interface ICurrencypairSearchProvider
A data provider that can be searched for a currency pair. A currency pair has neither ISIN nor exchange, so this search is separate from ISecuritySearchProvider; it only finds the identifiers a connector needs for its URL extension when they cannot be built from the two currencies, such as the onvista notation or the Boursorama symbol.

Like the security search, a currency pair search never throws: every failure is reported through the status of the result.
